references.text: The question of whether anything is too difficult for the Lord, a similar theme concerning God's will and purpose
Jacob saw God face to face and survived, the same fear of dying after seeing God
The belief that no one can see God and live, which Manoah's wife refutes with her reasoning
Gideon also feared he would die after seeing the angel of the Lord, but was assured that he would not die
The people's fear of hearing God's voice and dying, a similar theme concerning divine revelation
A burnt offering accepted by the Lord with fire, a similar acceptance of the sacrifice
Isaiah feared he would die because he had seen the Lord, the same theme of fear at divine revelation
God's purpose was revealed through sparing life rather than taking it, a similar logic regarding God's will
